MATPROF-SoftEng-01 completed read-only. No files changed, simulation jobs run, or further agents delegated.

Examined nODD commit `530080cfe16c7513228bf60238b99d4b9938538a` and clean ODD submodule commit `d70556f33b1c36abdf101a07ad8cf57eb56fbdf1`. Applied the explicit SoftEng mandate and `nodd-review-validation` skill.

The strongest source-level explanation is geometry representation:

- nODD builds fresh solids and material-bearing volumes for every XML constituent. Barrel, layer, stave, module, disc, petal and long-strip groups are predominantly `Assembly` objects.
- ODD reuses module/stave templates and gives barrel/endcap layers real Air envelopes. `ODDStripBarrel_geo.cpp:53–74` shows its physical barrel/stave envelopes and single module-template construction; repeated placements and cloned DetElements follow.
- If DD4hep converts assembly hierarchies into imprints in the nearest material-bearing mother, nODD loses most of its navigational hierarchy. This is a hypothesis requiring the coordinator’s Geant4 hierarchy/profile evidence.

Pinned nODD source locators:

- `PixelComponents.cpp:51–95`: new module assembly, substrate, sensitive patches and passive constituents on every call.
- `PixelComponents.cpp:98–143`: assembly stave; real core → pipe → coolant nesting.
- `PixelBarrel.cpp:20–47`: fresh layer/stave/module assemblies throughout the repetition loops.
- `ShortStripBarrel.cpp:31–42,49–76`: fresh volume per piece and assembly-only barrel/layer/stave/module hierarchy.
- `ShortStripEndcap.cpp:24–32,36–55`: equivalent disc/petal/module construction.
- `LongStrip.cpp:11–13`: assembly mother/groups; new solid and volume for every piece. Global piece transforms are preserved; there are no physical module envelopes.
- Each strip factory constructs a `SubtractionSolid` per XML cut. Shape families include boxes, tubes/sectors, tori and extruded shoes; pixel feet additionally use intersections.

Read-only inventory of the existing generated compact gives:

| Component | Source-derived material volumes | Assemblies |
|---|---:|---:|
| Beam pipe | 2 | 0 |
| Pixel barrel | 40,114 | 3,137 |
| Pixel endcap, each side | 27,377 | 1,166 |
| Short-strip barrel | 243,684 | 8,357 |
| Short-strip endcap | 108,744 | 4,477 |
| Long-strip barrel | 128,922 | 230 |
| Long-strip endcap | 85,776 | 170 |
| **Total, excluding world** | **661,996** | **18,703** |

These counts follow factory construction from the XML; they are **not runtime Geant4 counts**. There are 45,646 sensitive leaves, 567,126 strip pieces and 47,344 cuts. Strip pieces include 527,834 boxes, 16,958 tubes, 10,480 tori, 5,890 shoes and 5,964 sectors.

A direct test of the flattening hypothesis is **approximately 649,614 world daughters**: total material volumes minus 11,806 patches nested in substrates, 328 cooling daughters nested in pixel cores, and 248 coolant parts nested in endcap parts. All 567,126 strip pieces have assembly-only ancestors. Inspect actual Geant4 world/max-daughter counts and `G4SmartVoxelHeader` call stacks before attributing measured time.

The artifact inventory also found:

- `tracker.xml`: 200,451,288 bytes; SHA-256 `a27b807cbeda51c21b2994fdd5f5c60f96585ff54d788209f61a3a6bdc282ed3`.
- `materials.xml`: 1,396 material definitions and 98 elements.
- ODD’s two upstream definition files contain 21 material definitions plus 98 elemental material definitions. This compares definitions, not materials actually traversed.
- All four assembly-input hashes embedded in `expected.json` match pinned nODD source. This does not establish compiled-library identity or a fresh export.

**Exact ODD tracker selection:** `xml/OpenDataDetectorTracker.xml` includes `detectors/Solenoid.xml`. That solenoid carries `DetType_TRACKER`, so tracker-type filtering does not reliably exclude it.

Create a derived wrapper from pinned `OpenDataDetector.xml` that preserves elements/materials, envelopes/types, identifiers, visualization, ACTS support and plugins. Include the original BeamPipe, TrackerPixels, TrackerShortStrips and TrackerLongStrips descriptions and retain the `OpenDataTracker` assembly/plugins. Remove only the Solenoid include from that tracker description; omit calorimeter, muon and field sections. Preserve PST and every tracker support/service definition. Resolve relative includes through their original source directory or explicitly recorded absolute references.

For matched world extent, nODD currently specifies half sizes `(4000,4000,4100) mm`; these contain ODD’s retained tracker and ±4000 mm pipe. Record any wrapper world change explicitly. Preserve native material recipes and document differences: ODD’s pipe is 23.6–24.4 mm, nODD’s 27–27.8 mm; both extend ±4000 mm. nODD also explicitly models a vacuum bore. Do not remove these differences to improve speed.

Recorder setup at `nodd_material_recording.py:29–92,137–153` matches the requested initial settings: CLI default **100 tracks/event**, seed 228, uniform eta, zero vertex width/mean, neutral invalid-PDG probes, one thread, `gen3=False`, no element fractions, and ROOT pre/post-step output with recalculated totals. The callable function separately defaults to 10,000 tracks, so benchmark commands must specify `--tracks 100`.

Actual checks were Git identity/status inspection, pinned `git show` reads, and standard-library XML/hash inventories. No native performance ranking, source-to-binary verification, transport validation or design sign-off is claimed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
